in_sanskrit.name: आश्विता
in_sanskrit.meaning: Horse, Vehicle, Vehicle of the Gods
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: आश्व (Aashva) + ता (Ta) = आश्विता (Aashwita) = Horse, Vehicle, Vehicle of the Gods.

in_marathi.name: Ashwita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashwita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ashwita is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of two syllables: Ashu (horse) and Ita (victorious). It is a name that signifies strength, power, and triumph over adversity. In Hindu mythology, the god Indra is often depicted riding on a horse, symbolizing his power and dominance over the heavens. Ashwita is a name that is deeply rooted in the rich cultural heritage of India and is a beautiful choice for a baby girl.
